question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word. **
solution:
The correct answer is '**Agregate**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The incorrectly spelled word is: Agregate.
 
• **Agregate** (Incorrectly spelled, the correct spelling is "**Aggregate**.")
 
• Meanings of the words:
 
 
• **Adjacent** (पास) - next to or adjoining something else.
 
• **Accomplish** (पूरा करना) - achieve or complete successfully.
 
• **Aggregate** (समूह) - a whole formed by combining several separate elements; the total of something.
 
 
• ***Example sentence using "aggregate":**__ The aggregate income of the company increased significantly over the past year.*
 
 
 
• **Allure** (आकर्षण) - the quality of being powerfully and mysteriously attractive or fascinating.
